Notion is great as a team workspace... capacities is geared towards taking notes and building a knowledge base. You just create ideas, questions, books, notes, .. and connect them afterwards with related ideas, creating a network of thoughts.

Have been using it for a while now, there are really some cool new concepts... all media is automatically treated as an entity that can be reused, tagged, and organized... A lot of similarities to Notion (mostly in a good way), but a very nice implementation of daily notes, and tags for example that Notion lacks.
